title: Code review
summary: How changes are reviewed before they are merged, so that every change has a second pair of eyes and a record of why it was made.
scope: Every repository that holds code or configuration that reaches a shared environment.

requirements.title: Every change is reviewed
requirements.statement: Changes reach the main branch only through a pull request approved by at least one person who did not write them.
guidance: Protect the main branch: require one approval and passing checks.
For Tier 0 applications require two approvals.

verification.description: Branch protection applied by the repository automation.

requirements.title: Say what and why
requirements.statement: The pull request description says what changes and why, and links the ticket or request it belongs to.
requirements.rationale: The description is what people read in a year to understand the change.

good: Add retry to the billing client. The billing API returns 503 during deploys (INC-4821); three retries with backoff remove the errors.

lookFor: An empty description, or one that only repeats the title
No reference to a ticket, incident or request

requirements.title: Small pull requests
requirements.statement: A pull request changes one thing and stays under about 400 changed lines, generated files aside.
requirements.rationale: Reviewers miss more in large changes.
guidance: Put generated code and lock files in their own commit.

lookFor: More than about 400 changed lines of hand-written code

requirements.title: Tests with behaviour changes
requirements.statement: A change in behaviour comes with a test that fails without it.
requirements.rationale: Without a test the behaviour can silently change back, and the reviewer has to take the change on trust.

lookFor: Changed logic with no added or changed test
Tests removed or skipped to make the build pass
